questions.answer: Reading is my main one, usually with a cup of tea in the evening. I also enjoy long walks by the river and watching cricket, which becomes something of an [[obsession]] during big tournaments.

questions.q: Did you have any hobbies as a child?
questions.answer: Plenty. I collected stamps, flew kites on the rooftop and played cricket whenever I could. Kite flying was my favourite, and I'd spend hours trying to [[outmanoeuvre]] the neighbours' kites and cut their strings.

questions.q: Do you prefer doing hobbies alone or with others?
questions.answer: It depends on the hobby. Reading and writing I much prefer in [[solitude]], in a quiet corner. But sport and travel are far better shared, because the fun is really in the company.

questions.q: Is there a new hobby you would like to try?
questions.answer: Yes, I'd love to learn photography properly. I already enjoy taking casual shots, so mastering the technical side, like lighting and composition, feels like a natural and exciting [[progression]].

questions.q: Do you think it's important to have hobbies?
questions.answer: I really do. Hobbies give you a break from the pressure of work and let you do something purely for enjoyment. Without them, life can easily become a [[monotonous]] cycle of working, eating and sleeping.
